method: Enjaz Payment Services was incorporated as a 100% subsidiary on 11 Aug 2022 (a start-up, not an acquisition), so its income is organic. No acquisitions, disposals or discontinued operations were found FY2022-9M2026.

Material one-off revenue item: gain on disposal of property and equipment, net, FY2025 148,618 (FY2024: 167; proceeds 233,412) from the cash-flow statement. Step = 148,618 - 167 = 148,451 = 2.6 pp of FY2024 TOI; organic growth = 9.2% - 2.6 pp = 6.6% (calculated 6.55%).
assumptions: The income statement does not show the gain separately; we assume it sits in other operating income (300,441 vs 103,890), the only income line that rose enough. The 9M2025 cash-flow statement shows no gain, so it arose in Q4 2025.
notes: 9M2026 gain on disposal of property is only 116 (SAR '000), so no adjustment for 9M2026/9M2025.
